title: Release signing key unavailable
summary: Simulate a release signer being unavailable when a trusted artifact is due.

trigger.description: The documented release signer cannot access signing material.

assumptions: A signing policy may require a human handoff.
Secrets are never read by the drill.

inputs.name: signing_policy
inputs.description: Reviewed description of signer quorum and handoff.

score.formula: 100 when a tested alternate signer path exists; otherwise 100 minus a bounded release-blocking penalty

recovery_actions: Review a least-privilege alternate signer procedure.
Run a dry-run release using non-production credentials.
limitations: Does not inspect or expose signing keys.
Does not publish an artifact or attest its provenance.
